title: Give every feature YAML a urn, a status, and a non-empty acceptance section

facts.note: Sole activation condition: the file is a feature YAML. Feature files are identifiable by their planner location and YAML kind; the exact path glob is repository-specific (see context.repo-topology.idioms). Applies whether the file is being created, edited, or only inspected/validated; operation is not a prerequisite.

fires: A new feature YAML is created for a wagon.
An existing feature YAML is edited (e.g. its acceptance section is restructured).
An existing feature YAML is inspected or validated without any modification, and it lacks a status field or has an empty acceptance section.
A repository-wide validation pass checks all feature YAMLs, including ones untouched by the current change.
doesNotFire: A wagon or WMBT file that is not a feature YAML is created, edited, or inspected.
Code or test files are changed and no feature YAML is involved.

given: A file is a feature YAML (newly authored, edited, or already existing)
when: the feature YAML is written, reviewed, or validated
then: The feature YAML declares a urn, a status, and a non-empty acceptance section.
prefer: Fill in urn, status, and at least one acceptance entry when first creating the feature file.
Keep the acceptance section populated when restructuring a feature.
When an existing feature YAML is found missing any of these fields, bring it into shape rather than treating pre-existing files as exempt.
avoid: Leaving acceptance as an empty list/map or placeholder just so the key exists.
Omitting urn or status on the assumption they are inferred from the file path or wagon.
why: Downstream planning artefacts — component URNs, component derivation from ioSeeds/WMBTs, and wagon/WMBT coverage checks — presuppose a well-formed feature with these fields.
evidence: Parsing each feature YAML (new, edited, or pre-existing) shows a urn field, a status field, and an acceptance section with at least one entry.

A finding is reported for any feature YAML where urn is missing, status is missing, or the acceptance section is missing or empty — detected by parsing the file's current content, not only by diffing a change.
verifier_detail: Required fields (term required_fields): urn, status, and a non-empty acceptance section.
Disposition is documentation-only (severity 2): report the finding; it is not a strict-failing gate.

Detection of missing/removed/empty fields is a verification step on the parsed YAML (needs a YAML-parse observer), not an activation prerequisite; run it on every feature YAML in scope, including unmodified ones.
